decision: infrastructure-void; not a measurement of model quality
cause: Retained workspace analyses carry "Model enrichment abstained: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE: Declared model is absent from provider inventory." on 29 of 30 cases even though five consecutive /models listings had included muse-spark-1.3-contributor immediately before launch; the provider inventory alternates between pools. The single dispatched call (first case) hit UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT at the 180000 ms command deadline.
consequence: Scores measure inventory availability and the deadline, not diagnosis or healing quality; they are not compared with targets and are no evidence toward or against any gate. Deterministic controls and policy probes are unaffected.
followUp: The gateway retries an intermittently missing inventory entry (up to four listings) and the model command deadline ceiling is 600000 ms (commits up to fc8eeb0). A new sealed family, reference-helpdesk, is authored after that implementation freeze and evaluated in round 6; reference-library is considered exposed to two void rounds and is not reused.
